description: Excel-like spreadsheet component with support for cell editing, formulas, styling, formatting, multi-sheet workbooks, freeze panes, merge cells, auto-fill, and XLSX import/export. Features row virtualization for smooth performance with large datasets, a formula engine with 100+ built-in functions, and a full ribbon toolbar.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: XLSX file data to load into the spreadsheet on initialization.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: CSS height of the spreadsheet container.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: CSS width of the spreadsheet container.

parameters.name: RowsCount
parameters.description: Initial number of rows to render.

parameters.name: ColumnsCount
parameters.description: Initial number of columns to render.

parameters.name: OnChange
parameters.description: Fires when a cell value changes.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Fires when the active cell or selection changes.

parameters.name: OnCellEdit
parameters.description: Fires when a cell enters or exits edit mode.

parameters.name: OnOpen
parameters.description: Fires when a file is opened via the toolbar.

parameters.name: OnDownload
parameters.description: Fires when the workbook is downloaded.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the root element.

parameters.name: InitialWorkbook
parameters.description: Pre-populates the spreadsheet with an existing workbook on first render. Subsequent parameter changes are ignored — read the Workbook property to get the current state after editing.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Controls the display and interaction mode of the spreadsheet. Defaults to Full.

usedAbstractions.name: SpreadsheetWorkbook
usedAbstractions.description: Root workbook model containing sheets and active sheet reference

usedAbstractions.name: SpreadsheetSheet
usedAbstractions.description: Individual sheet with cells, rows, columns, merged cells, and freeze panes

usedAbstractions.name: SpreadsheetCell
usedAbstractions.description: Cell model with value, formula, style, and display value

usedAbstractions.name: SpreadsheetCellStyle
usedAbstractions.description: Cell styling including font, colors, borders, alignment, and number format

usedAbstractions.name: SpreadsheetRange
usedAbstractions.description: Cell range for selection and merge operations (e.g. A1:B10)

usedAbstractions.name: SpreadsheetNamedRange
usedAbstractions.description: Named range with workbook or sheet scope for use in formulas

usedAbstractions.name: SpreadsheetHyperlink
usedAbstractions.description: Structured hyperlink supporting web, email, internal ref, and named range

examples.title: With custom dimensions and XLSX data
Programmatic API - set values and export
Formula engine with 100+ functions
XLSX import/export
examples.code:
<InputFile OnChange="OnFileSelected" accept=".xlsx" />
<TmSpreadsheet @ref="_spreadsheet" />

@code {
    private TmSpreadsheet _spreadsheet = null!;

    private async Task OnFileSelected(InputFileChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        using var stream = e.File.OpenReadStream(5 * 1024 * 1024);
        using var ms = new MemoryStream();
        await stream.CopyToAsync(ms);
        await _spreadsheet.ImportFromExcelAsync(ms.ToArray());
    }

    private async Task ExportAsync()
    {
        var data = await _spreadsheet.ExportToExcelAsync();
        // download bytes...
    }
}
